what: Once the title’s top edge crosses the 65% line of the screen, it plays once — on each line a text-colored bar grows from the left until it covers the line (.5s), then .44s later it clears from the left and the text is revealed in its place (.5s). Each line is .1s later than the last, with the curve cubic-bezier(.92,.09,.13,.97). The bar does not stay behind, it just passes through. At 1024px and below and with reduced motion, only the text is shown with no bar

options.step: Length of cover and uncover each (sec), default .5 — 0 means instant
options.reveal: Seconds from start of covering to start of walking, default .44
options.delay: First line delay (sec), default 0 — original body paragraphs show the symbol first, so .81
options.start: Line where it turns on (ScrollTrigger start), default top 65% — for load, right on attach
options.narrow: At or below this width (px) it is left without a bar, default 1024
options.--fx-bar-top · --fx-bar-bottom: Bar top and bottom ends (relative to the text box), default .12em · -.05em
options.[data-fx-part=line]: One row — holds text and bar inside

use: First lineSecond row

from.where: index.html·works.html·focus.html .rp-line (every section title and intro paragraph — shared.js wipeLine). The hero title gets the same bar sweeping through once in 1s (sweepInto)
